title: Palo Alto Networks Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management
summary: For the eighth consecutive time, Palo Alto Networks is recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access

For the eighth consecutive time,


Palo Alto Networks


is recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner


®


Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access


Management.


Once again, it is positioned furthest along in Completeness of Vision and has been positioned so in every Magic Quadrant published for this category.


[Read the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management.](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/gartner-magic-quadrant-for-privileged-access-management.html)


Identity is not a siloed risk. As an increasingly attractive target for threat actors, it must be understood and secured across the entire attack surface.


F


or our customers, the benefit is clear: as part of Palo Alto Networks, Idira helps you adopt AI innovation at speed while retaining control over privileged access.


## Why


Vision Matters Most Right Now


The 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluates providers across their Ability to Execute and Completeness of Vision. We feel that being positioned furthest in Completeness of Vision matters most in moments of technology change like this one. Idira is built for an environment where:


- Identity is the attack surface, and frontier AI lets attackers move faster, increasingly logging in rather than breaking in.


- Identities have exploded, and human and machine privilege alike must be controlled.


- The pace of change has never been higher, as organizations race to adopt AI and modernize infrastructure without losing control.


Customers need a partner that can execute on an innovative vision as the threat and technology landscape evolves. With the scale of Palo Alto Networks behind us, we are focused on securing every identity and every moment of privilege in the AI enterprise.


## The AI Era Demands More From PAM


We are in a new era, where identity and access have fundamentally changed. Machine identities now


[outnumber humans 109 to 1](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/idira-identity-security-landscape) , AI agents (which require access to enterprise systems to do useful work) are entering the workforce, and


[attackers have noticed](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-assisted-cyber-attack-inside-a-unit-42-investigation/) . That access must be governed alongside the human and machine identities already protected. Increasingly, though, attackers log in rather than break in, and


[PAM](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cyberpedia/what-is-privileged-access-management) must evolve to stay ahead of these challenges. PAM must now extend beyond vaulted administrator credentials to discover, control, and govern privilege across the enterprise.


Idira’s Modern PAM platform is enabling PAM to meet the demands of the AI era; it combines vaulted access and


[zero standing privileges](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cyberpedia/zero-standing-privileges) (ZSP) with secrets management,


[workload security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine) , and


[identity governance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-and-access-management) . We are bringing ZSP to every modern target, including cloud, apps, and


[Kubernetes](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/identity-security/zero-standing-privilege-managed-kubernetes/) . And access challenges go beyond humans, so Idira does as well. To secure non-human access, Idira added


[native SPIFFE/SVID](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/identity-security/ai-agent-security-spiffe-machine-identity/) support to deliver short-lived cryptographic identities to workloads and AI agents. Our ability to deliver and innovate on our vision enables Idira to deliver purpose-built, end-to-end protection at scale for the modern AI enterprise.


## Modernizing PAM: Where We Deliver


Making modern PAM easier to adopt is central to our approach.


While some of the largest organizations continue to trust Idira for our proven traditional PAM leadership, they now also rely on us to guide their modern PAM transformation initiatives.


**Data-Driven Innovation** : We believe that our Transformation Decision Engine, which uses customer environment data to quantify the value of PAM modernization, combined with our years of proven experience guiding both the implementation and modernization of PAM programs across our expansive customer base, demonstrates our ability to help customers through any stage of their PAM journey with an informed, data-driven approach.


**Customer Experience:** Idira guides cross-functional security teams through complex operational shifts, from standing access to ZSP, supported by the


[Idira Blueprint](https://docs.cyberark.com/welcome/latest/en/content/welcome/blueprint.htm) , hands-on training, and an active peer community


**.**


**Scale and Reach:** Idira customers already have a partner with global reach, and joining Palo Alto Networks extends it further. Our security platform sees identity risk across the whole attack surface, so a stolen or abused privilege becomes a signal your defenses act on in the moment, backed by the investment and expertise of the industry's largest cybersecurity company.


## Ready for the Demands of the AI Enterprise


Eight reports, eight times furthest in vision. I'm grateful to the customers whose trust and expertise shaped every one of them. This is also a first, as it’s the first report to carry the Palo Alto Networks name. Since Idira joined forces with Palo Alto Networks, our


[PAM expertise](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/privileged-access-management) and platform now sit inside the industry's leading cybersecurity company, where privileged access connects to


[real-time threat detection and response](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xsiam) ,


[AI security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/prisma-airs) , and


[Unit 42 threat intelligence](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/threat-intelligence) .


The next chapter of privileged access is being written now, by attackers with frontier AI models and by enterprises deciding how fast to move. We intend to stay furthest ahead of both.


Thank you to our customers and community for your trust, and for the partnership that helps shape our innovation.

**How can PAM help secure AI agents in the enterprise?**


PAM can help secure AI agents by controlling their access to systems and data, protecting the secrets they use, and recording their access and actions. Capabilities vary by solution; controls should limit each agent’s permissions and how long those permissions remain active. Learn more about


[Idira Agentic Identity Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/agentic) .


**How does zero standing privileges differ from vaulted access?**


Vaulted access protects stored privileged credentials. ZSP removes standing privileged access by granting permissions for a specific task and revoking them when the task or authorized period ends. Modern PAM can combine both approaches to support different environments and access needs.
